evidence: Traupman 18: fairly well, mediocriter quidem valeō
terms.comment: Lewis & Short has mediocriter “moderately, tolerably” as classical (corpus mediocriter aegrum, Cic. Tusc. 3.22), but not with valeō; the phrase is Traupman’s.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 15, 18.
